definitions.DefaultCard: {content?: string; assigneeId?: UserId | null; priority?: Priority | null; effort?: number | null; masterTags?: string[]}
definitions.Workdays: {monday: boolean; tuesday: boolean; wednesday: boolean; thursday: boolean; friday: boolean; saturday: boolean; sunday: boolean}

descriptions._root: The starting point of every query.
descriptions._root.account: The organization the request is for.
descriptions._root.loggedInUser: The user the request acts as. For an organization's API token it's the token's own user. `null` when nobody is signed in.
descriptions._root.releases: The entries of the Codecks changelog.
descriptions.account.handCards: The bookmarked cards of all users.
descriptions.account.projects: Projects that are neither archived nor deleted.
descriptions.account.queueEntries: The cards in the Card Hand of all users.
descriptions.account.resolvables: The comment threads of all cards.
descriptions.account.allowInheritHeroCover: `true` makes the web app show a hero card's cover image on its sub cards, in place of their own.
descriptions.account.attachmentCoverMode: Which uploaded image attachment becomes the card's `coverFile`. `first` only sets it if the card has no cover yet, `last` always uses the newest image, `none` never sets it.
descriptions.account.effortScale: The effort values the web app offers for a card. A card's `effort` may still be any other number.
descriptions.account.fallbackEffort: The effort the web app counts for cards without an `effort`, e.g. in charts, hero cards and run capacity.
descriptions.account.hideCompletedCardCountForDecks: `true` hides the number of done cards on decks in the web app.
descriptions.account.maxHandSlotCount: How many cards that aren't done each user may have in their Hand, between 7 and 28. `handQueue/addCardsToHand`, `handQueue/setCardOrders` and `cards/create` with `putInQueue` fail beyond it. Starting a card and hand sync can still go beyond it.
descriptions.account.priorityLabels: The names the web app shows for the card priorities `a`, `b` and `c`.
descriptions.account.startWeekday: The first day of the week in the calendar and timeline. Users can override it for themselves.
descriptions.account.statusChangeDurations: In seconds. A started card without changes for `snooze` seconds becomes `snoozing`. A done card without changes and open comment threads for `archive` seconds gets archived. `archive` is `null` when done cards never get archived.
descriptions.account.subdomain: The part before `.codecks.io` in the organization's web address.
descriptions.account.timeTrackingMode: `none` turns time tracking off. `manual` allows only manual time entries. `strict` also adds a timer that users start with the play button on a card.
descriptions.account.timelineScaleType: Whether the timeline shows days or weeks. Users can override it for themselves.
descriptions.account.workdays: The days the team works. The web app only counts these days, e.g. for the days left until a milestone.
descriptions.account.workflowMode: `journeys` when the organization uses journeys, `only_parent_cards` when not.
descriptions.attachment: A file attached to a card.
descriptions.attachment.content: The attachment's label as markdown. It starts as the file name.
descriptions.attachment.title: The first line of `content` as plain text, cut to 80 characters.
descriptions.card:
A task or a document card when `isDoc` is set or a hero card if it contains sub cards.
The card's color is derived from `status`, `visibility`, `isDoc` and whether it has sub cards or open block or review conversations.
descriptions.card.attachments: In the order the card shows them.
descriptions.card.childCards: A hero card's sub cards, in order.
descriptions.card.coverFile: The image shown on the card's front.
descriptions.card.creator: `null` for cards an import created.
descriptions.card.deck: `null` for a private card, which only its creator sees.
descriptions.card.handCards: One entry per user who bookmarked the card.
descriptions.card.inDeps: The cards that have to be done before this one.
descriptions.card.outDeps: The cards that wait for this one. The counterpart of their `inDeps`.
descriptions.card.parentCard: The hero card this card is a sub card of.
descriptions.card.queueEntries: One entry per user who has the card in their Card Hand.
descriptions.card.resolvableEntries: Every comment on the card, across its threads.
descriptions.card.resolvables: The card's comment threads, including reviews and blockers (`context`).
descriptions.card.sourceWorkflowItem: The journey step the card was created from.
descriptions.card.sprint: The run the card is planned into.
descriptions.card.accountSeq: The card's number within the organization. It's stored as a plain number starting at 1. The web app shows it encoded as a short code after a `$`, like `$12a`. Check [this gist](https://gist.github.com/danielberndt/19857421171dbb07a3681f0ea6634049) for how to translate the number into the shown string and vice versa.
descriptions.card.checkboxStats: How many checkboxes `content` has, and how many of them are checked.
descriptions.card.content: The card's text as markdown. Its first line is the `title`. Tags, mentions, checkboxes and card references in it fill `tags`, `masterTags`, `mentionedUsers`, `checkboxStats`, `checkboxInfo` and `cardReferences`.
descriptions.card.coverFileId: The image shown on the card's front.
descriptions.card.deckId: `null` for a private card, which only its creator sees.
descriptions.card.derivedStatus: The state the web app shows, combining `status`, `visibility`, `isDoc`, open review and blocker threads, the assignee and whether it's a hero card: e.g. `blocked` for an open blocker thread, `unassigned` for a not started card without an assignee.
descriptions.card.isBlockingDep: The card isn't done yet, and one of its `outDeps` isn't either.
descriptions.card.isDoc: `true` for a document card: it holds information instead of a task, so it's never started or done.
descriptions.card.masterTags: The card's project tags: the tags from the project's tag list, whether written as `#tag` in `content` or set directly, plus the deck's auto-tag. Writing them may change `content`.
descriptions.card.parentCardId: The hero card this card is a sub card of.
descriptions.card.priority: `a`, `b` or `c`: High, Medium and Low, unless the organization renamed them (`account.priorityLabels`).
descriptions.card.sourceWorkflowItemId: The journey step the card was created from.
descriptions.card.sprintId: The run the card is planned into.
descriptions.card.status: `snoozing` is only set on a `started` card that nobody changed for the organization's snooze time (`account.statusChangeDurations`). It can't be written. `derivedStatus` is the state the web app shows.
descriptions.card.tags: Every tag on the card: the `#tags` in `content` and the `masterTags`, each once.
descriptions.card.title: The first line of `content` as plain text, without markdown and cut to 80 characters. Write `content` to change it.
descriptions.card.version: Goes up with every change to the card.
descriptions.card.visibility: `archived` cards are put away, `deleted` ones are in the trash. Both stay readable.
descriptions.cardHistory: One version of a card and what changed in it. The web app shows these in the card's history.
descriptions.cardHistory.diff: The changed fields: `[old, new]` for single values, `{"+": added, "-": removed}` for lists, and an encoded text diff for `content` and `title`.
descriptions.deck: A list of cards within a project. `deckType` says which kind of cards it is meant for.
descriptions.deck.defaultProjectTag: The deck's auto tag. Cards that are created in or moved into the deck get this project tag.
descriptions.deck.milestone: Setting it also puts the deck's cards into this milestone.
descriptions.deck.workflowItems: The steps of the deck's journey.
descriptions.deck.accountSeq: The deck's number within the organization. The web app uses it in the deck's URL, like `/decks/12-my-deck`.
descriptions.deck.deckType: The web app calls these Task (`task`), Asset (`hero`), Knowledge (`doc`) and Mixed (`mixed`) decks. Cards in a `hero` deck count as hero cards unless they are docs or sub cards. A started card that moves into a `hero` or `doc` deck goes back to `not_started`.
descriptions.deck.defaultCard: The deck's Template Card. The web app fills in these values when you create a card in this deck. `cards/create` doesn't use them.
descriptions.deck.defaultProjectTagId: The deck's auto tag. Cards that are created in or moved into the deck get this project tag.
descriptions.deck.handSyncEnabled: Cards in this deck that have an assignee go into the assignee's Hand. This happens when a card is created, moved into the deck or gets a new assignee.
descriptions.deck.hasGuardians: The deck has [guardians](https://manual.codecks.io/guardians/). Then only guardians, producers and admins may mark its cards as done or not done, archive, delete, restore or move them.
descriptions.deck.manualOrderLabels: The names of the zones in the deck's manual order, in order. `null` is a zone without a name. A card's zone is the `label` of its `cardOrder` in the `deck` context.
descriptions.deck.milestoneId: Setting it also puts the deck's cards into this milestone.
descriptions.deck.sortValue: Decks within a space are sorted by it. Change it with `decks/addToSpaceAfter` or `decks/addToSpaceBefore`.
descriptions.deck.spaceId: The space of the project the deck is in, one of the ids in `project.spaces`.
descriptions.file: An uploaded file, like a card attachment or a cover image.
descriptions.file.size: In bytes. `0` once the file is deleted.
descriptions.file.url: Where to download the file. `""` once the file is deleted.
descriptions.handCard: A card a user bookmarked. Deleting the card removes its bookmarks.
descriptions.handCard.sortIndex: Bookmarks are listed by ascending `sortIndex`. There may be gaps.
descriptions.milestone: A date that cards are planned towards. It belongs to a list of projects, or with `isGlobal` to all projects of the organization.
descriptions.milestone.accountSeq: The milestone's number within the organization. The web app uses it in the milestone's URL: `/milestones/<accountSeq>`.
descriptions.milestone.handSyncEnabled: Its cards that are not done and have an assignee are added to the assignee's Hand.
descriptions.milestone.isGlobal: The milestone belongs to all projects of the organization, also to projects created later.
descriptions.milestone.manualOrderLabels: The names of the zones the web app groups the cards into when they are ordered by hand, in order. `null` is the zone without a name.
descriptions.milestone.userCapacities: The planned effort per user, keyed by user id. The web app compares it with the effort of the user's cards, where a card without `effort` counts as `account.fallbackEffort`.
descriptions.milestoneProgress: The state of a milestone's cards on a day (UTC). A row is only written on days when the numbers change, so a day without a row has the numbers of the row before it.
descriptions.milestoneProgress.progress: Counts the cards in decks of active projects by their `derivedStatus`, with all done states counted as `done`. `cards` and `effort` have the card count and the effort sum for each state (`done`, `started`, `review`, `blocked`, `snoozing`, `assigned`, `unassigned`, `hero`), `stats` has `[count, effort sum, cards without effort]` for each state and `noEffortCards` counts the cards without effort. States without cards are left out.
descriptions.milestoneProject: Links a milestone to a project whose cards and decks can use it. A milestone with `isGlobal` is linked to every project.
descriptions.project: Groups decks. A card belongs to the project of its deck.
descriptions.project.milestoneProjects: Links to the milestones this project can use.
descriptions.project.sprintProjects: Links to the run configs this project can use.
descriptions.project.tags: The project's tag list. A card in the project with one of these tags lists it in `masterTags`.
descriptions.project.spaces: The spaces that group the project's decks. Removing a space moves its decks into the first remaining one.
descriptions.project.visibility: Setting `archived` or `deleted` closes all open comment threads on the project's cards.
descriptions.projectTag: A tag in a project's tag list. A card in the project with this tag lists it in `masterTags`.
descriptions.projectTag.color: A hex color like `#ff0000` for cards with this tag. The web app sets either `color` or `emoji`, not both.
descriptions.projectTag.description: What the tag is for, as markdown.
descriptions.projectTag.tag: Without the `#`. Renaming it also renames the tag in the `content` and `masterTags` of the project's cards.
descriptions.queueEntry: A card in a user's Hand. When a card is done, its owner gets an entry in their Hand's done pile, even if the card wasn't in their Hand.
descriptions.queueEntry.cardDoneAt: When the card was done. Other users' entries for the card are removed then. Setting the card back to not done moves the entry to the end of the Hand.
descriptions.queueEntry.sortIndex: The position in the Hand, `0` is the first card. `null` once the card is done.
descriptions.release: An entry in the Codecks changelog. It's the same for every organization.
descriptions.resolvable: A comment thread on a card. Its `context` says if it's a plain conversation or if it marks the card as blocked or in review.
descriptions.resolvable.closedBy: `null` while the thread is open, or when it was closed automatically.
descriptions.resolvable.reopenedBy: Only set while the thread is open again after being closed.
descriptions.resolvable.context: `block` marks the card as blocked and `review` marks it as in review while the thread is open (see `card.derivedStatus`). `comment` is a plain conversation.
descriptions.resolvable.isClosed: Archiving or deleting the card closes its open threads.
descriptions.resolvable.reopenedAt: Only set while the thread is open again after being closed. Closing it clears the value.
descriptions.resolvableEntry: A comment in a comment thread.
descriptions.resolvableEntry.lastChangedAt: When the comment was last edited. Same as `createdAt` if it never was.
descriptions.resolvableEntry.version: Starts at 1 and goes up with every edit.
descriptions.resolvableEntryReaction: An emoji reaction to a comment. A user can add each emoji only once per comment.
descriptions.sprint: A run: one time box of a Run Config, from `startDate` to `endDate`. Codecks creates the upcoming runs ahead of time and completes a run when it ends.
descriptions.sprint.autoMilestone: Cards that are added to this run get this milestone, unless they already have one.
descriptions.sprint.accountSeq: The run's number within the organization. The web app uses it in the run's URL: `/milestones/run/<accountSeq>`.
descriptions.sprint.autoMilestoneId: Cards that are added to this run get this milestone, unless they already have one.
descriptions.sprint.completedAt: When the run was completed, at its end or with `complete` in `sprints/updateSprint`.
descriptions.sprint.endDate: The last day of the run.
descriptions.sprint.handSyncEnabled: A card that is created in this run with an assignee is added to the assignee's Hand.
descriptions.sprint.index: The position of the run within its Run Config, starting at 0. The web app shows `index + 1` as the run's number.
descriptions.sprint.lockedAt: When Beast Mode started for this run. In Beast Mode the run's cards are locked in, and moving one of them to another run raises its Beast level. `null` while it is off.
descriptions.sprint.manualOrderLabels: The names of the zones the web app groups the cards into when they are ordered by hand, in order. `null` is the zone without a name. A new run starts with the zones of the run before it.
descriptions.sprint.name: `null` unless set by hand. The web app then shows a label from the Run Config's `runLabelTemplate`, or `Run <index + 1>`.
descriptions.sprint.userCapacities: The planned effort per user, keyed by user id. The web app compares it with the effort of the user's cards, where a card without `effort` counts as `account.fallbackEffort`. A new run starts with the capacities of the run before it.
descriptions.sprintConfig: A Run Config. It creates runs of the same length one after the other, like sprints, for its projects.
descriptions.sprintConfig.progress: The daily history of the done cards across all runs.
descriptions.sprintConfig.autoAssignNewCard: The web app puts new cards in its projects into the current run. Journeys do the same, `cards/create` doesn't.
descriptions.sprintConfig.autoAssignStartedCard: A card in one of its projects that is started without a run is added to the current run.
descriptions.sprintConfig.autoBeastModeDurationHours: Beast Mode starts on its own this many hours after the start of a run, counted from midnight in the Run Config's time zone. `0` starts it right away, `null` turns it off.
descriptions.sprintConfig.beastGracePeriodHours: In Beast Mode, a card added to the run is only locked in after this many hours. Until then it can move to another run without raising its Beast level.
descriptions.sprintConfig.isGlobal: The Run Config belongs to all projects of the organization, also to projects created later.
descriptions.sprintConfig.moveOnFinish: Which cards move to the next run when a run ends: `review` for cards with an open review, `blocked` for cards with an open blocker and `undone` for all other cards that aren't done. Archived cards and docs stay.
descriptions.sprintConfig.runLabelTemplate: The label for runs without a `name`. `%RUN_NR%` becomes the run's `index + 1` and `%CALENDAR_WEEK%` the ISO week of its `startDate`. `null` means `Run %RUN_NR%`.
descriptions.sprintConfigProgress: The done cards of all runs of a Run Config on a day (UTC). A row is only written on days when the numbers change, so a day without a row has the numbers of the row before it.
descriptions.sprintConfigProgress.progress: `stats.done` is `[count, effort sum, cards without effort]` of the done cards in all runs, counting only cards in decks of active projects.
descriptions.sprintProgress: The state of a run's cards on a day (UTC). A row is only written on days when the numbers change, so a day without a row has the numbers of the row before it.
descriptions.sprintProgress.progress: Counts the cards in decks of active projects by their `derivedStatus`, with all done states counted as `done`. `cards` and `effort` have the card count and the effort sum for each state (`done`, `started`, `review`, `blocked`, `snoozing`, `assigned`, `unassigned`, `hero`), `stats` has `[count, effort sum, cards without effort]` for each state and `noEffortCards` counts the cards without effort. States without cards are left out.
descriptions.sprintProject: Links a run config to a project whose cards can be planned into its runs. A run config with `isGlobal` is linked to every project.
descriptions.user: A person, or an integration or API token that acts in an organization. `kind` tells them apart.
descriptions.user.kind: `integration` is the user an integration like GitHub or Slack acts as, `api_token` the one an organization's API token acts as.
descriptions.user.name: The username. `""` when none is set. An API token's user carries the token's label.
descriptions.user.timezone: An IANA time zone like `Europe/Berlin`. Only readable on your own user: `null` on everyone else's.
descriptions.workflowItem: A Journey Step: a template for a sub card. Starting a deck's journey on a card creates a sub card from each of its steps.
descriptions.workflowItem.assignee: The owner of the created card.
descriptions.workflowItem.deck: The deck whose journey the step belongs to.
descriptions.workflowItem.inDeps: Steps of the same journey that have to be done before this one. The created cards get the same dependencies.
descriptions.workflowItem.outDeps: Steps of the same journey that are blocked by this one.
descriptions.workflowItem.targetDeck: The deck the created card goes to. Without one, it goes to `deck`.
descriptions.workflowItem.accountSeq: The step's number within the organization. It comes from the same counter as `card.accountSeq`.
descriptions.workflowItem.assigneeId: The owner of the created card.
descriptions.workflowItem.content: Markdown for the created card's `content`, see `card.content`. `%PARENT_TITLE%` is replaced by the title of the card the journey is started on.
descriptions.workflowItem.deckId: The deck whose journey the step belongs to.
descriptions.workflowItem.label: The name of the group the step is in. `null` for the default group.
descriptions.workflowItem.sortValue: Steps are ordered by ascending `sortValue`, compared as strings, within their `label` group.
descriptions.workflowItem.targetDeckId: The deck the created card goes to. Without one, it goes to `deck`.
descriptions.workflowItem.version: Goes up with every change to the step.
descriptions.workflowItem.visibility: Only `default` steps are used when a journey is started. Changing an archived or deleted step sets it back to `default`.
